selftest: route-run R4c course selftest (docs/route-runs/PLAN.md R4c): master's Marlow Yard sets A1 and A2 (J12 S9's graph) and their points. Run with --players 2 (expect.players). a1-gate crosses A1 (the wall by two stubs) and clears holding room one's far door through its airlock (onLockedDoor), ending in a2-west so the page is in bay 2; the A2 runs raise the shunter in the neck through the page (course.raise, ctx.selftest: SR2) once (one seen set restart, rejoined) and twice (the second pushed past with the spotted rule off). Each run's course block is checked by course.mjs checkCourseExpect (SR5). node scripts/route-run.mjs <url> --selftest tests/fixtures/route-run/selftest-course.graph.json checks it (with SR1-SR5 in).

meta.name: Marlow Yard (sets A1 and A2)
meta.note: Fixture (route-runs R4c): the A1 Gate and A2 Carriage Shed spaces and links (0-20) of J12 S9's as-built yard graph, origin/feature/validator-port-s9 docs/marlow-final/graph/ctcourse.json at b6464dd95 (meta.measured from it, splits dropped: A1 / A2 have none). No taught_by: two sections of a fixture, not the whole course (the planner's full training run is not what this checks).
meta.points_note: Points by hand: each space's first area box, centre its middle at the storey's floor; each link's declared at (atFrom 'declared') except links 3 and 6. a1-walltop has no nav cells (S9 measured: 'no area / floor cells on a1-walltop'), so a harness placement cannot leave a robot on the wall top (driver place snaps to the nearest walkable cell) and a walk to a point 4.4 m up never arrives (progress STOREY_Y_TOL_M 1.5). So the leg-up (3) is held at its mark on the apron floor (A1_MARK (10.8, 6), the link's note; atFrom 'mark'): its stub leaves both robots on the apron floor. The drop (6) has its point at the apron foot of the wall below its declared point (atFrom 'stub', a stand-in). Since R5 drops are walked, and this one cannot start on the wall top (no nav cell there): DropStep walks to the stand-in and pushes into the locked wicket, so a1-gate expects a step-timeout dead stop on link 6 at its limit; the recovery then places both robots past it in the yard (12.6, 0, 11), and 8 and 9 are walked from there. R9's real leg-up and a wall-top placement (a driver change) are what would let it walk.
meta.drills_note: Master's yard lists no drills (every CourseDef bay's drills is empty: src/world/maps/ctcourse.ts:103 takes p.bay.drills, which no set pushes), so the airlocks cycle as soon as both robots are on the pad: course.drills passes with no drill stubs and the A13 hold never runs here (the drill-gate path is unit tested in tests/routeRunCourse.test.ts). L1-near and L2-near are not course locks on master (an airlock's near door locks only once it cycles); L1-far is, until L1 cycles (courseState.ts:637-643).
